state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper studies process supervision via iterated decomposition, a human-in-the-loop workflow that incrementally improves a task decomposition through error diagnosis and amendment: start with a minimal decomposition into subtasks a LM can perform (e.g. extracting the placebo used in academic studies by first finding the most relevant section, then generating the placebo given that section), then apply it to multiple test inputs with gold standard answers.
title: Iterated decomposition loop: start minimal, apply to gold-standard test inputs
